design.question: When OFAC begins designating parties under a sanctions programme aimed at a country, how does that country's trade with the United States change relative to its trade with the rest of the world, product chapter by product chapter, compared with countries not (yet) targeted?

treatment.absorbing: later designations are part of the post-period path
treatment.definition: cohort g = first calendar year with at least 5 OFAC designations under the target's programmes (a party counts in the year of its earliest entry event; parties under several of one target's programmes count once)
treatment.earlier_targets: targets whose first wave precedes 2000 (Cuba, 1986) are dropped: no pre-period
treatment.gate_numbers: 16 targets have a first wave in 2000-2021: IRQ 2003; IRN, COD, BLR 2006; SOM, PRK 2010; LBY 2011; RUS, UKR 2014; CAF, VEN 2015; SSD 2017; NIC 2019; CHN 2020; MMR, ETH 2021. Gate: at least 10 of them must have a chapter with positive exports both to the US and to others in the panel, else the study is not estimable.
treatment.later_targets: Sudan 2023, Lebanon 2023, Hong Kong 2026 serve as not-yet-treated comparisons until their wave
treatment.never_treated: every other country in BACI (the United States itself excluded)
treatment.programmes_not_mapped: thematic programmes (SDGT, SDNT, SDNTK, NPWMD, TCO, CYBER*, ILLICIT-DRUGS*, FTO, ELECTION*, HOSTAGES*, ICC*, GLOMAG, NS-PLC, PAIPA, IFCA), human-rights programmes aimed at officials (MAGNIT, HRIT-IR, HRIT-SY, IRAN-HR, UHRPA) and multi-country BALKANS programmes. The Russia-targeting UKRAINE-EO13661/13662 (Russian officials and sectors) map to RUS; UKRAINE-EO13660/13685 and RUSSIA-EO14065 (persons in Ukraine, Crimea, the occupied oblasts) map to UKR.
treatment.source: event_library: library_type sanctions_designation from ofac_sanctions (SDN and non-SDN lists, earliest entry date per party)
treatment.survivorship: The lists are current. Parties delisted before retrieval are absent: terminated programmes (Syria 2025, Zimbabwe 2024, Liberia, Cote d'Ivoire, Balkans in part) look untreated here and sit among the comparisons, which biases the estimate toward zero; surviving programmes may be dated late when their first-wave parties were later delisted.

units.clusters: country (treatment is assigned to whole countries)
units.definition: exporting country (BACI ISO3; statistical areas and the United States excluded) x HS1992 chapter (2-digit)
units.strata: HS chapter: every comparison is to other countries' exports of the same chapter

overall.definition: equal-weight mean of ATT(e) over the post event times listed

outcome.label: log(country's exports to the US) - log(its exports to all other importers), by HS1992 chapter (BACI, thousand USD)

equal-weight mean of ATT(e) over the post event times listed
equal-weight mean of stacked ATT(e) over post event times

twfe_static.warning: biased under staggered adoption with heterogeneous or dynamic effects; comparison only

assumptions: Parallel trends: absent treatment, the average outcome of treated units would have moved like that of the comparison units (not-yet-treated or never-treated, within stratum when stratified) from the base period on.
No anticipation beyond the registered anticipation window: outcomes before g - anticipation do not respond.
Absorbing treatment: the first qualifying event defines the cohort; later events are part of the post-period treatment path, so estimates are effects of entering treatment, not of one isolated event.
SUTVA / no interference: a unit's outcome does not depend on other units' treatment (spillovers to comparison units bias the estimate toward zero or away from it).
Treatment timing is recorded correctly by the source date the registration names.
Absent the programme, the target's US-versus-rest trade ratio in a chapter would have moved like that of not-yet-targeted countries in the same chapter.
Shocks that coincide with a programme move the target's trade with the US and with others proportionally; US-specific shocks (other US trade measures, diplomatic ruptures) are not removed.
The first year with 5 programme designations dates the programme's economic bite; programmes that began with an executive order but few listings are dated at their first sizeable listing year.

BACI's reconciled mirror flows measure trade with the US with error unrelated to the programme (sanctioned trade may be misreported or rerouted through third countries, which the outcome would read as a fall).
Survivorship of the current lists biases toward zero (see treatment.survivorship).
identification.estimand: ATT: equal-weight mean over event times 0..3 of treated-count-weighted ATT(g, g+e) on the log US-versus-rest ratio; a value of -0.1 means the target's trade with the US fell about 10% relative to its trade with everyone else
identification.label: did_failed_diagnostics
identification.meaning: A difference-in-differences estimate whose pre-registered diagnostics failed. It is reported for transparency and must not be read as an intervention response.

results.verdict: No causal claim. Pre-registered diagnostics failed (placebo_cluster_size), so the parallel-trends design is not credible here. The estimate for log(country's exports to the US) - log(its exports to all other importers), by HS1992 chapter (BACI, thousand USD), -0.1146 log points (95% CI -0.2673 to +0.0381), is reported only for transparency.

identification.meaning: Average effect on the treated identified by a staggered difference-in-differences design whose pre-registered diagnostics (pre-trends, placebo dates, placebo units) all passed. Causal only under the stated assumptions, for the treated population and horizon studied.

results.verdict: Diagnostics passed; the effect on log(country's imports from the US) - log(its imports from all other exporters), by HS1992 chapter is a null: -0.1207 log points (95% CI -0.3089 to +0.0676). The design rules out average effects outside that interval under the stated assumptions.
